HYPE.thesis: Hyperliquid retains strong fee-to-token buyback linkage; buybacks remain material, but price is near record highs and OI/crowding is elevated.
HYPE.invalidation: Buyback/value-capture weakens materially, core crypto-perp activity deteriorates, or supply/crowding risk overwhelms demand.

UNI.thesis: Protocol fees are active on v2 and selected v3 pools and convert protocol revenue into UNI burns; current repricing has fundamental token-value-capture support.
UNI.invalidation: Fee/burn implementation weakens materially, governance reverses value capture, or spot demand fails after the current repricing.

ARB.thesis: ARB is showing strong relative strength alongside ecosystem/revenue catalysts, but the current move is already large and supply/unlock risk remains relevant.
ARB.invalidation: Revenue/value-capture thesis fails to persist, ecosystem activity rolls over, or unlock/supply pressure dominates.

NEAR.thesis: Strong relative-strength breakout and broad alt rotation make NEAR worth immediate research, but slow fundamental confirmation is incomplete.
NEAR.invalidation: Relative strength/spot demand fades without corroborating non-price catalyst or adoption evidence.
